title: Figure 12: Captured laser power vs range from 11.2 µm CO2 laser
description: Log-scale graph of laser power captured by the Lightcraft (W, 1E+04 to 1E+07) against Lightcraft slant range from laser (0-500 km) for an "11.2 micron Laser Wavelength". Curves compare laser beam angles of 0° and 83° from the vertical, plus a "No Adaptive Optics" case. Caption: "Figure 12. Captured Laser Power vs. Increasing Range from 11.2 µm CO2 Laser [26]."
